system.description:
At the summit of the art, the countermage sweeps a rival's sorcery from the air around them before it can ever take hold.

Using Countermagic is a free action. Make a Mental Challenge against the caster with six extra Traits; on a win the opposed Thaumaturgy power or ritual fails. You may now cancel any power or ritual that targets anything within a radius equal to your Willpower in yards, or that is being cast within that radius. Your rating must equal or exceed the power opposed, and it is fully effective only against Tremere Thaumaturgy, weakened by four Traits against other blood magic and useless against other powers.
